nom: Avène Cleanance Cleansing Gel Soap Free Cleanser for Acne Prone, Oily, Face & Body, Alcohol-Free

avis.texte: I love this cleanser! This is one of the only cleansers that keeps my combo, hormonal cystic acne prone skin clear while managing oil production. I keep coming back to it time and again. With regular use blackheads even are diminished. It's got a pleasant scent and lathers even though it's soap free. You only need about a nickel size of product each time you use. A sample bottle lasted what seems like an eternity so the full size will last a loooong time. It can make me feel a little dry at times, but it's easily combated with a good moisturizer. I use either Embryolisse Lait Creme or Caudalie Moisturizing Sorbet depending on how dry my skin feels. I find that the minimal dryness after using is better than being an oil slick mess with breakouts and it doesn't make me flaky. I would NOT recommend this cleanser if you have dry skin normally. As it is I mostly use this cleanser when the seasons change and the weather becomes warmer and my oil production is kicked into high gear. This cleanser also removes makeup insanely well. My face is always bright, smooth, and clean after using and feels refreshed. This cleanser won't be for everyone but if you have oily acne prone skin I'd give it a try. Maybe try to find a sample bottle first, and definitely follow up with a good moisturizer that you know does not break you out. I love Avene's products and I will continue to have this cleanser on hand at all times, even in the colder months when I don't use often, it'll clear up a breakout

avis.titre: Nothing worked for my bacne — until this
avis.texte: Worth trying for bacne — it solved my issue. I used to struggle with cysts, nodules, whiteheads, and blackheads, mostly on my back and occasionally on my shoulders. Sometimes it was painful and left scars that took a long time to heal. I tried everything — salicylic acid, AHA, benzoyl peroxide, adapalene — and followed all kinds of routines: applying products by hand, using a back brush, washing once or twice a day, even full skincare routines. Nothing ever worked. I also paid close attention to the cleanliness of my bedsheets, bath towels, and T-shirts, but it didn’t help. Then, about two months ago, an employee working in the cosmetic aisle of a well-known pharmacy suggested this product. While they weren’t a pharmacist, their advice turned out to be excellent. I’m now on my second bottle, purchased on Amazon, because I’m truly satisfied. My skin has cleared up completely. It feels deeply clean after each use, yet not dry — just smooth and soft. My pores are unclogged. No more pimples — not even a small one, whether deep or on the skin’s surface. It doesn’t foam much, but I think that’s part of the gentle formula. I apply it to wet skin, rub gently with my fingers until I get a rich lather — it takes some time — then rinse well with water. Sometimes I pat dry; other times I let it air dry. avis.titre: A seemingly basic prodcut but so rewarding when it works beyond your expectations
avis.texte: This face wash is fantastic especially in the summer. I remember reading so many beauty articles that said how important it is to wash with a clear face washes ( as opposed to creamy, thick ones) in the morning especially when it’s warm to help combat perspiration, oils slicks etc. This really makes my face feel as if I dunked it into a cool, tranquil and mineral rich turquoise sea and it washes out any bits of morning slept in impurity while still maintaining very soft and comfortable skin which is rare. This prevents any extra oil build up from the start, being a clear not creamy face wash, and my makeup always stays on perfectly placed and not caked. My boyfriend also likes to use it so it’s for anyone really, I just love how refreshing and soothing it feels and the bottle has a fabulous little Sci-Fi / fancy opening which is neat and it lasts quite a bit. This wash is thicker than it looks so I get to enjoy it for a few months per bottle. I adore Avene and I haven’t used a product yet that doesn’t impress. The mineral rich thermal waters that their cosmetics are based on are truly healing and wonderful for the skin, I’ve been a fan for a bit now, can’t wait to see what else they come up with. This stuff can be used in the morning or at night, it’s a very versatile and soothing product with wonderful purifying and calming qualities and it smells divine and not fake, like a raging sea in a bottle full of skin loving nutrition, one of my favorites. -Kasia S.
Love this clearing gel. Have been using for awhile. It cleans without drying out my skin. This is trusted part of my daily skincare routine.

This cleanser is good for sensitive combination skin. It clean very well without leaving your skin feeling dry. With any new products that I use I can tell within the first 24 hours if my skin likes it or not because I will start breaking out almost immediately. I have been using this for a few days and I have not had any breakouts. The one negative thing I would have to say is this soap has fragrance. It’s not over powering but it’s definitely there. If you don’t like a lot of fragrance then I don’t think this would work for you. I wish they would make a fragrance free one

avis.titre: Love the scent, doesn't irritate skin
avis.texte: I normally use the Clinique facial bar to wash my face but I try to keep something bottled to use in the shower because the bar tends to disintegrate faster if it's left in a wet environment. I had been using a foaming innisfree cleanser that left a slight burning sensation on my cheeks so I switched to this and it's been fantastic. Its got a slight scent that isn't overwhelming, I would say it reminds me of the "ocean breeze" scent of some candles, it comes out sort of runny (more liquid than gel), and has a slight sudsing (no crazy foaming action). I like to use it with an ultrasonic scrubber to get my makeup off at the end of the day and it gets a decent enough lather to help it glide across my face better. The Clinique soap doesn't lather as much and sometimes I feel like the scrubber can kind of stick as it goes across. I know you're supposed to avoid scents in skincare as much as possible but it's such a luxurious feeling that I'm not mad but I do try to stick to using it only once a day but so far my skin hasnt had any kind of irritation and it doesn't feel extremely stripped the way it did when I used the Innisfree foaming wash. Overall I'm really happy with my purchase and would buy again

I use it together with my husband every day for more than 4 months. I am 32, I have very oily skin, open pores, acne, and blackheads. I have these issues all my life since maybe 15 years old. Now, when I am older, the situation is much better, but I still have some issues. My husband is also 32, he has normal skin, some blackheads on the nose. They are very hard to squeeze out and every time it is a whole story :-) About 9 months ago we moved to Florida and in fall my husband started to notice some acne on his cheeks. The pimples were white and red. I asked my cosmetologist, sent her photos, and she recommended him to use this gel. She now works in Europe and this company is very popular out there. She told his pimples appeared due to infection (perhaps he touched his face with dirty hands). I bought this gel and decided to use by myself also. Result: Husband after about a month of use doesn't have any pimples. The skin on his cheeks is even and soft. The blackheads are still on the nose :-) I still have the acne, but now I have other issues. Immediately after each wash, I feel dry skin. But after about half an hour, a lot of fat is released on the cheeks and on the forehead (I can directly wipe it with my fingers and see a shiny substance). I transcripted the barcode to know that the country of manufacture is France and the item was produced legally and Yes, everything is good. We used this gel as instructions recommend. So, in my mind, this gel is not suitable for all skin

avis.titre: This stuff is a hidden gem

My photo is post workout at 5 am lol so don’t mind the redness but you can see how shiny and even my skin looks.
